title.zh-CN: 肢体麻木与行走困难 · 11岁7个月男孩
title.en: Limb numbness and difficulty walking · boy aged 11 years 7 months

summary.zh-CN: 感染后出现进展性无力与吞咽变化，住院后又出现新的中枢神经表现。
summary.en: Progressive weakness and swallowing changes follow infection, with new central neurological features later during admission.

text.zh-CN: 曾因呼吸肌麻痹插管后拔管。第28天头痛、意识异常、抽搐、视力下降，血压随后升至135–150/78–98 mmHg；MRI枕顶叶等多灶异常。

text.zh-CN: 报告按PRES方向控制抽搐和血压等，4天视力恢复，约20天眼球活动恢复，第43天MRI病灶消失；6个月无再发抽搐或视力损害，肌力恢复，仍减量抗癫痫药。
text.en: Following management of seizures and BP for suspected PRES, vision recovered in four days, ocular movements in about twenty days and MRI lesions disappeared by day 43. At six months there were no recurrent seizures or visual deficits and power had recovered, while antiseizure medication was being tapered.

prompt.zh-CN: 最初无力和反射改变支持什么方向？
prompt.en: What initial direction is supported by weakness and reflex changes?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 急性周围神经病方向，并警惕球部与呼吸肌风险
text.en: An acute peripheral neuropathy with bulbar and respiratory risk

feedback.zh-CN: 进行性对称无力、反射消失及电生理支持周围定位。
feedback.en: Progressive weakness, areflexia and neurophysiology support peripheral localisation.

text.zh-CN: 仅单侧脑卒中解释所有初期表现
text.en: A unilateral stroke alone explains the initial findings

feedback.zh-CN: 对称周围性改变和蛋白细胞分离不符合此单一解释。
feedback.en: The peripheral pattern and protein–cell dissociation do not fit that single explanation.

text.zh-CN: 入院未气促就无须监测呼吸肌
text.en: No admission dyspnoea means respiratory monitoring is unnecessary

feedback.zh-CN: 神经肌无力可进展，吞咽异常已提示重要风险。
feedback.en: Neuromuscular weakness can progress and swallowing changes already signal risk.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 后续抽搐视力改变与高血压需考虑PRES等新中枢过程
text.en: Later seizures, visual change and hypertension require consideration of PRES or another new central process

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把所有新神经症状自动归为原来的周围神经病。
feedback.en: New neurological symptoms must not all be attributed automatically to the original peripheral neuropathy.

text.zh-CN: 原有GBS足以解释新MRI病灶，无须再评估
text.en: Original GBS explains the new MRI lesions without reassessment

feedback.zh-CN: 新的中枢影像和急剧血压变化需要独立评估。
feedback.en: New central imaging changes and abrupt hypertension need separate assessment.

text.zh-CN: 出现失明即可断言永不恢复
text.en: Visual loss proves permanent irreversible blindness

feedback.zh-CN: 报告后续恢复，初始不能仅凭严重程度预言永久结局。
feedback.en: Later recovery was reported; severity alone does not establish permanent outcome.

prompt.zh-CN: 新的中枢事件出现后应怎样处理？
prompt.en: How should the new central event be managed?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 紧急神经与重症评估血压、抽搐和可逆诱因，并复核序贯影像
text.en: Urgent neurological and critical-care assessment of BP, seizures and reversible triggers with serial imaging

feedback.zh-CN: 需及时控制风险，同时不能把某项既往治疗直接定为唯一病因。
feedback.en: Risks require timely control without declaring one prior treatment the sole cause.

text.zh-CN: 只继续肢体康复，忽略血压和视力
text.en: Continue limb rehabilitation alone and ignore BP and vision

feedback.zh-CN: 急性中枢症状可能危及生命或造成永久损伤。
feedback.en: Acute central symptoms may threaten life or cause permanent injury.

text.zh-CN: 已证明所有病变都由免疫球蛋白造成
text.en: Immunoglobulin is proven to have caused all lesions

feedback.zh-CN: 疾病自主神经异常及多种治疗并存，因果不能单独归因。
feedback.en: Autonomic disease and multiple treatments coexist, preventing a single causal attribution.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：用反射和电生理定位初始无力。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：PRES的独立诱因、完整DWI/ADC资料及更长期神经结局。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Localise the initial weakness using reflexes and neurophysiology. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Independent PRES trigger, complete DWI/ADC findings and longer-term neurological outcome. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告为GBS病程中出现PRES，早期周围神经病和后期中枢事件应分阶段解释。
conclusion.en: The report describes PRES during GBS; the early peripheral neuropathy and later central event require staged interpretation.
